Case reference: 2016068414.CaseDesc: On August 30, 1965, this unidentified male was found on the shore of Lake Ontario just east of the harbour pier in Oshawa. Case reference: 2012020070.CaseDesc: Leslie Thomas was reported missing on  December 8, 2000.  He was last seen walking west on Highway 201 in the Roseau River First Nation located south of Winnipeg in Manitoba, during the first week of November 2000.  Leslie's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014001664.CaseDesc: On September 12, 1982, Harold Larcher and his girlfriend set out on Lake Winnipegosis in separate canoes with their supplies from the Overflowing River in Manitoba. After the river, they were in view of big waves on the lake. Their canoes began to fill with water from the same waves.  His girlfriend's canoe overturned, but she could see that Harold was still in his canoe as she struggled to right her own. She was unable to do so, but at one point she was able to sit on it and eventually made her way to shore, but never saw Harold again. Numerous personal items were recovered, including Harold's passport and a lifejacket that may have belonged to him.  It is presumed that he drowned.

Case reference: 2019032078.CaseDesc: On June 8, 2019, at aprroximately 2:19 pm, Shauranne Humphry was seen for the last time at the Anduhyaun Shelter in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014005582.CaseDesc: Lionel Joseph Daigle went missing from the New Direction Special Care home, located on the west side of the city of Saint John, New Brunswick, on April 3, 2011. Lionel is reported to have mental health issues and requires regular medication. The public is urged to contact the Saint John Police Force with any information concerning his whereabouts.

Jacket: Grey, Winter jacket, 3/4 length with hood

Case reference: 2014003036.CaseDesc: Originally from Winnipeg, Manitoba, Regan Pace Ambrose is believed to have gone missing in Japan. After being recruited to work at a Japanese hospital, Miss Ambrose moved to Tokuyama, Yamaguchi, Japan. She was last seen on January 11, 1998 after finishing a shift at work. She was reportedly seen in the area of Mount Aso in Kumamoto, Kyushu Japan on January 10th, 1998. Japanese and Canadian authorities investigated; however, met with negative results.

Case reference: 2019048180.CaseDesc: On August, 11, 2019, Miranda Belle was seen for the last time by her ex-spouse at a family gathering in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Miranda was last heard from via Facebook, on August 17, 2019.

In his possession were a "Hipstreet" brand MP3 player and headphones. The images shown are facial approximation portraits of this unidentified man created by the Sûreté du Québec.

Case reference: 2014004687.CaseDesc: Gertrude Power is originally from the Maritimes and was last heard from by family members in the 1970s, when they suspected she was living in British Columbia, where she may have worked as a waitress on Vancouver Island.  She was known as "Trudy."

They never returned home and have not been seen since, Jean and Jean-Guy were reported missing on July 10, 1972.

Jewelry: Silver, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, wedding ring on the left ring finger
Gold, Gold, ring on the left ring finger

Case reference: 2014005589.CaseDesc: On May 1, 1971, Lillian Giroux was seen for the last time when she was left with relatives in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014001522.CaseDesc: On July 7, 1977, James Stackhouse and a colleague were camped on a small island on the east shore of Lake Winnipeg, north of Hole River in Manitoba. Their vessel was drifting southwards, approaching Deer Island, which is situated 6 kilometres south of their current position. At approximately 6:00 p.m., the two men departed the shore, each holding onto small logs that had been tied together. They attempted to swim to Deer Island, but strong currents and waves carried them instead to a location east of Deer Island. The improvised raft constructed by the men was compromised, leading to their separation. The friend swam to Deer Island, but unfortunately James was not seen again. Extensive searches of the area were conducted using a variety of methods, including land, air, and water, but the body of James was not recovered.

Shirt: Blue, T-Shirt with text "Bermuda" on chest

Case reference: 2014003255.CaseDesc: On September 06, 1976, Charles Lewsaw was seen for the last time near Newmack well site located 8 km North of Red Earth Creek, Alberta.

Case reference: 2013000125.CaseDesc: Bonnie Joan Thomas (born Cooper) of Rollingdam, outside of St. Stephen, New Brunswick, met some friends and went across the U.S.A. border to the Legion in Calais, Maine. They went to a St. Patrick's Day dance and after the evening's celebrations, Bonnie left the Legion alone in her 1973 red Volvo station wagon. Bonnie drove back through the Calais/St. Stephen border crossing into Canada. At the Canadian entry point, Bonnie hit the customs booth causing minor damage to her car and was last seen talking to the Customs Officer. The following morning Bonnie's husband realized she was missing, and called the police. On March 18, 1978, Bonnie's car was found abandoned near St. Stephen on a logging road near the St Croix River.

Case reference: 2023001420.CaseDesc: On November 7, 2022, Sohail Shahid was seen for the last time at Terrapin Point, American Falls, Niagara Falls, New York. Witnesses observed Sohail jumping over the railing. At the time of his disappearance, Sohail was despondent.

Case reference: 2016006093.CaseDesc: On January 19, 2016, Michelle Smits was seen for the last time as she travelled from Cambridge, Ontario to the United States. In February, Michelle’s vehicle was found abandoned in Boston, Massachusetts.

Case reference: 2021056970.CaseDesc: On November 12, 1998, the remains of an unidentified woman were recovered from North West Connoire in Newfoundland. The woman had a complete fusion of the proximal and intermediate phalanges of her right ring finger. This fusion would have rendered her joint completely immobilized.

Case reference: 2013000015.CaseDesc: On November 6, 1968, Robert Lessard went onto the Ottawa River in a boat, travelling to a hunting camp. He never arrived and the boat was located on the river.

Case reference: 2014004252.CaseDesc: Gordie Dixon was reported missing by his family on 19 March 1990 in Eden Valley, Alberta.  Gordie may have been seen on the Macleod Trail in Calgary, Alberta a few months before he was reported missing.

Police have conducted a comprehensive search of the area surrounding Sioux Lookout for Jeremy, but have so far been unsuccessful. It has been speculated that he may have been heading towards a camp located north of Pickle Lake.

Case reference: 2005003499.CaseDesc: On July 22, 2002, a Caucasian male, was found in the Niagara River, near the Queenston Dock in Niagara Falls. When Thomas did not return home later that evening, he was reported missing. According to the acquaintance, the car had run out of gas while traveling on a forest road behind the local mill. The acquaintance left to walk back to town and Thomas had decided to stay with the car. The car was located on the forest road but Thomas Jones was not located.

Case reference: 2014002841.CaseDesc: Michel Gagné was last seen on June 29, 1982, in Montreal, Quebec. Michel left his friend's mother's home to go with him to a medical clinic and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2015050297.CaseDesc: On April, 23, 1973, Lucie Gélinas was seen for the last time in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. She was supposed to go to Vancouver, British Columbia with a friend. Investigations were conducted and the location of Lucie and her friend have been unsuccessful.

Case reference: 2014005758.CaseDesc: Jack Smith was last seen leaving his home in Elk Lake, Ontario on October 22, 1972 walking east on Secondary Hwy 560. Jack was going hunting and was carrying a .22 caliber rifle and a small backpack.

Case reference: 2014003491.CaseDesc: On June 12th, 1981, Gordon Westover was seen at a local beer garden in Fort St John, BC at approximately 11:00 PM. Mr. Westover left the gathering in an unknown direction and has not been seen or heard from since. Mr. Westover has a mild mental disability and has been known to impersonate professional people such as police, firefighters, military and doctors. Mr. Westover told several people at the party that he was going to join the military, but no records show Mr. Westover was ever recruited. Mr. Westover has not been seen or heard from.

Case reference: 2014004318.CaseDesc: On the morning of April 13, 2001, Céline Goyette was dropped off at her husband Richard Gleeson's residence, located on Forestwood Street in Rosemère, Quebec. Since that time, she has not been seen and has not given any more news to her relatives. Moreover, her spouse Richard Gleeson has also disappeared since that time.

Case reference: 2014003793.CaseDesc: On November 2, 1980, Keith Dufour was seen for the last time at his residence in the town of Amherstburg, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Keith was suffering from mental health issues.

While they were out on the lake the winds picked up and began to create large waves, which caused the boat to capsize. Charles and his friend clung to the bottom of the boat but were pushed off several times by the waves. Charles was washed away from the boat. As he attempted to swim back to the boat, his head kept going under water.  At one point he did not resurface.

Jacket: Canvas, Brown, Orange, Hunting - ONG shoulder patches

Case reference: 2014004024.CaseDesc: On December 6, 1989, Ernestine Kasyon was seen for the last time while leaving a residence to use a payphone in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan.

All his belongings were left behind at the campground where he had been staying.

Shoes: Leather, Black, CASUAL, with metal tips

Case reference: 2014005870.CaseDesc: André Bellemare was last seen by his wife on May 22, 2012, at his residence in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Case reference: 2014004496.CaseDesc: Peter Cortner was last seen on May 20, 2004. He was reported missing by his apartment manager where he resided in Downtown Vancouver. He had left all his belongings behind in his apartment suite and disappeared without notice.

Searches of the area have failed to locate any sign of Emily.
